Name: Dave the Miner for Content Patcher
Author: XxHarvzBackxX
Description:
Ever wonder who collects Clint's ore? That's where Dave comes in! With a fully new NPC, custom location accessed via the blacksmith's and lots of more to come!
Note: incompat with SVE because it's a pain in the ass to patch dave's hatch in. you can still play with dave but his room won't be accessible
[b][i][u]This mod includes:[/u][/i][/b]
- Dave (Full NPC).
- Dave's room in Clint's basement.
- A ladder to Dave's room in the Blacksmith's.
- A passageway to the mines inside Dave's room.

[b][i][u]Future updates will bring:
[/u][/i][/b]- Any bugfixes.
- Heart events.
- [b]EVEN MORE[/b] dialogue and schedules!
- More portraits and animations.
- Anything else that you guys want.

[b][i][u]Installation:
[/u][/i][/b][1] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3849]Custom NPC Fixes[/url].
[2] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[3] Download [CP] Dave the Miner.
[4] Drag all 3 to your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
[5] Enjoy all that Dave has to offer!
